scope: Frozen package-lock production dependency graph used to build browser JS/assets; excludes dev dependencies from audit, not Nginx/container OS packages
metadata_count_note: npm metadata still describes the complete lock graph (prod/dev/optional counts can overlap); --omit=dev determines the audited set. prod=117 does not mean 117 packages are installed in the Nginx image.
limitations: Known npm advisory results at this time; not a scan of Alpine/Nginx/zlib/BusyBox or the image base.
Root's earlier PowerShell-piped audit was parsed as context only; this separate subprocess captured and verified the actual npm exit code.
